method: Public SwiftJLI.Decoder.decode with allocated output; identical JPEG bytes; exact full-output comparison against source before timing; 5 warmups then20 individual decode samples per case;16 cases;2 rounds with binary order reversed. Input file reads and correctness comparisons outside timing. Three binaries run in reversed order across two rounds; all original samples retained.
compilerVersion:
Apple Swift version 6.4.2 (swiftlang-6.4.2.1.9 clang-2100.4.1.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
